intro: 本包依据执行包、爸爸原始 Word 的 22 条意见，以及 E:/QQ文件/1-----4A Stiky notes 中的实物及参考素材制作。英文销售正文与内部核验说明分开；没有修改 Seller Central，也没有覆盖原图。AI 图片为基于实物参考生成的设计审稿，不是实物拍摄或性能测试证据。
decisions: 用户已确认实际为22条，不存在缺失的第23—25条。原始Word已重新核对。
5082-Y-L：包装可见5×8英寸、2本、50张/本、100张总计及横线；旧x2/IMG_1.jpg视觉却出现四本，本版改为两本。现有FBA库存不在本次核验范围。
406x6三款：包装均可见4×6英寸、6本、100张/本、600张总计。单页为无横线长方形，不能沿用5082的横线纸。
5×8纸面40平方英寸，3×3纸面9平方英寸，面积比约4.44；4×6纸面24平方英寸，面积比约2.67。对外只写准确面积，不把整个纸面面积等同于有效可写行数。
406x6-Y原包装写PASTEL YELLOW；执行包建议Classic Canary Yellow。为避免色名与实物冲突，英文Listing和三色图均统一为Yellow。5082亦采用Yellow；没有篡改真实包装原字。
80 GSM、所有笔类均不渗墨、强力不脱落、无残胶及不卷边均未取得测试资料：不写成绝对保证。保留Smooth Writing Paper与Self-Adhesive等基本描述，实际纸张克重、胶带宽度和适用表面待工厂确认。
100%满意度保证不放入A+；环保包装、微晶胶技术与可完全替代法律信纸本均不作为已证实卖点。A+与主图遵循Amazon官方规范核查，不以300DPI标签代替实际像素质量。
三款406x6均是单独销售的6本装；展示三个色款不是一包18本。A+采用同一布局，但不能把Pastel描述不加区别应用于所有子体。

listings.title: 4A Lined Sticky Notes, 5 x 8 Inches, Yellow, 2 Pads, 50 Sheets per Pad, 100 Sheets Total, Large Self-Stick Notes for Lists, Work and Study
bullets: Room for the whole list
The 5 x 8 inch format gives you space for meeting notes, daily tasks and longer reminders on one sheet. Keep the details together instead of spreading a list across several small notes.
Lines that keep thoughts in order
Ruled pages help you organize checklists, action items and class notes. The yellow background makes handwritten reminders easy to spot among everyday paperwork.
Write, peel and place
Self-stick sheets let you place a reminder where you will see it. Apply to a clean, dry, smooth surface and press the adhesive area firmly; test delicate surfaces first.
Two pads for your routine
Includes 2 pads with 50 sheets each, for 100 sheets total. Keep one at your desk and another in your study or household planning area.
For work, home and study
Use the large lined pages for project steps, study summaries, household lists and daily priorities. A straightforward paper tool for keeping your next task in view.
listings.description: Give longer reminders room to breathe. 4A 5082-Y-L combines a large 5 x 8 inch sheet with printed lines for lists, meeting notes and everyday plans. Write down the details, peel off a sheet and place it on a suitable smooth surface. The pack includes two yellow pads, with 50 sheets per pad and 100 sheets in total. Pens, computers and other scene accessories are not included.
